prompts.task: Copy genai-default-audit.json into matching canonical .observe/otel-audit.json, validate it and request OTEL-001 using the bundled selection flow. Include repeated runs, mixed existing/missing resources, duplicate-conflict exact relookup, ID lookup-only and failed-lookup isolation; the OTEL-001-only case authorizes no project/Agent Stream provisioning or AO configuration side effects. Assess the isolated installed public start_splunk_ao_span/schema-helper evidence separately from logger-only enrichment limitations. Use supported helper capabilities at real source operations where evidenced, with same-span bounded safe mappings and parent context, while recording exact remaining operation-specific gaps such as the separate-process model requiring CLIENT when the probed helper emits INTERNAL. Do not turn either a logger-only limitation into a blanket SDK blocker or an in-memory helper probe into production exporter/app/cloud proof. This remains a plan-only task: preserve every input and source/profile/dependency/test file, and make no implementation or live creation claims. Separately assess the usage_registry_reconciliation cases in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json, using its independently captured full official registry receipt with exact path/revision/date/hash, not inferred absence from selected docs rows. Reconcile every newly proposed gen_ai.* usage field with that registry. Give a concrete useful mapping for the fresh case reported input17/output5 and source-derived total22 with count provenance, and assess the candidate proposal; separately preserve the exact existing legacy alias used by the supplied legacy consumer. Do not claim the older docs/schema snapshot has the new registry revision, or that any counterexample executed a real model. Apply official versus application/vendor versus proven legacy distinctions to actual app.py estimates and other source cases as applicable, without inventing absent fields or silently removing old consumer contracts. Separately reconcile operation_metadata_reconciliation in genai-fresh-ao-instrument-cases.json. Plan exact source-backed owning-agent/tool context fields for its fixed-model, dynamic-model and unbound source cases: configured agent description, applicable fixed agent request model, tool-owning agent, approved opaque conversation and actual tool definition description/type. Keep current official conditional/recommended levels and model applicability footnote separate from required known-field acceptance, never borrow context between cases or derive a description by paraphrasing a prompt. Assess known successful response finish reason and actual message choice indices, known expected abnormal generation slots and unknown generation counts; preserve produced partial output but invent no successful output, unknown placeholder reason or unsupplied slot/index. Inspect public-helper span creation versus finished fields using its exact installed source and the independently captured RecordingAlwaysOn should_sample/on_start receipt. A finished exporter view does not repair earlier sampler/on_start inputs; preserve valid existing OTel creation APIs, do not invent helper arguments or SDK patches/duplicate spans, and do not claim a demonstrated attribute-dependent DROP or AlwaysOn failure. These assessments remain a plan and scoped supplied evidence review, not new execution or integration success.
